b: Nearly three decades after the death of six-year-old JonBenét Ramsey turned a Boulder, Colorado, home into a national crime scene, Netflix has released the first trailer for The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey. The limited series, which premieres December 10, wastes no time putting Little Miss Colorado’s parents (Melissa McCarthy and Clive Owen) on trial in the court of public opinion.

The trailer opens on Patsy Ramsey’s frantic 911 call, followed by detectives and reporters circling the couple as theories pile up faster than evidence. Showrunner Richard LaGravenese says he was drawn to “a murder mystery without an ending, without being solved,” so it will be curious to see if the series can provide true-crime junkies with a satisfying narrative.

Created and written by Harrison Query and Tommy Wallach, the project has had a winding road to the screen, as Paramount+ shelved it before Netflix picked it up. The ensemble includes Garrett Hedlund, Alison Pill, Shea Whigham, Owen Teague, Clifton Collins Jr., Will Patton, and Margo Martindale, with Emily Mitchell as JonBenét.
